changeSet.author: mrowe-tan
changeSet.comment: Remove surrounding whitespace and trailing slashes from saved DSW server URLs (RSDEV-1657). New values are normalised when saved, and DSWClient appends paths that start with a slash. Only rows ending in a slash or whitespace are changed, so it is safe to run again.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE AppConfigElement ace JOIN AppConfigElementDescriptor aced ON ace.appConfigElementDescriptor_id = aced.id JOIN PropertyDescriptor pd ON aced.descriptor_id = pd.id SET ace.value = REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(ace.value), '[/[:space:]]+$', '') WHERE pd.name = 'DSW_URL' AND ace.value REGEXP '[/[:space:]]$';
